description: This file contains shell script functions and variables related to platform-specific firmware handling, including identification, validation, and upgrade procedures for devices using bcm47xx architecture, with logic specific to various device models and firmware formats.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a specified offset and outputs as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a specified offset, interprets as a little-endian long integer.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Determines the expected firmware image identifier string based on the device model read from /tmp/sysinfo/model.

methods.name: bcm47xx_identify
methods.description: Identifies the image type based on magic numbers and specific offsets within the firmware file.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Main function to verify the integrity and suitability of a firmware image for the device.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_chk_cmd
methods.description: Returns the command to extract TRX firmware from a CHK image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_cybertan_cmd
methods.description: Returns the command to extract TRX firmware from a CyberTAN image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxl_cmd
methods.description: Returns the command to extract TRX firmware from a Luxul LXL image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxlold_cmd
methods.description: Returns the command to extract TRX firmware from an old Luxul LXL image.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade using the appropriate extraction command based on image type.
